mainEntity.name: What is the best local dictation app for Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Apple Dictation for built-in text entry, Voice Control for voice-driven Mac control, Gojo for explicit local-model dictation into the focused text field, and MacWhisper when recordings, meetings, or transcript management are the main job.

It depends on the tool and configuration. Apple tells users to check Keyboard settings to see whether general Dictation is processed on-device. Voice Control works without internet after a one-time download. Gojo uses a downloaded local model for dictation.

mainEntity.name: Does Gojo send dictation audio to the cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gojo's dictation feature runs recognition on the Mac using a downloaded local model and does not require an API key or cloud transcription service.

Local processing reduces the need to send audio to a transcription server, but users should still check permissions, transcript storage, optional cloud features, analytics, and the behavior of the app receiving the text.

mainEntity.name: Does Gojo replace a meeting transcription app?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Gojo inserts dictated text into the field you are using. A transcription workspace is a better fit for recordings, speaker labels, transcript search, and meeting archives.

blocks.label: Short answer
blocks.copy: Apple Dictation is the simplest built-in choice. Apple Voice Control is for controlling the Mac as well as entering text. Gojo is the focused choice for explicit local-model dictation into the text field you are already using. MacWhisper is better suited to recordings, meetings, audio files, and transcript management.

content.s: Local is not a label to trust blindly. Check the exact feature, model, language, and setting you plan to use. A product may process one workflow locally and offer optional cloud services for another.

blocks.text: Choose by the job you need done
Apple Dictation: start with what is built in

content.s: Apple Dictation enters speech wherever you can type. It supports punctuation and formatting commands, and Apple silicon Macs can continue accepting keyboard input while you speak. It is the right first test when you want no additional app.

Do not assume every Dictation configuration is offline. Apple's current support guide tells users to read the text beneath Dictation in Keyboard settings to learn whether general voice input and transcripts are processed on-device or sent to Siri servers.

blocks.text: Voice Control: use speech to operate the Mac

content.s: Voice Control is an accessibility system for navigation, clicking, editing, and dictation. Apple says it needs internet for a one-time file download and then works without an internet connection. Choose it when hands-free control matters more than a lightweight dictation shortcut.

blocks.text: Gojo: dictate locally inside your existing workflow

content.s: Gojo downloads an explicit local speech model, performs recognition on the Mac, and types the result into the active text field. It fits short writing, replies, and idea capture when you also want window snapping, clipboard history, files, media, and display controls in the MacBook notch.
